version.description: The version of the language being generated, if not the most current.

indentStr.description: The text used for indentation. If this value is set to null, no indentation will be done.

newlineStr.description: The text used for separating lines. Cannot be null.

spaceStr.description: The text used for a single white space. Cannot be null.

title:
A code writer keeps track of source code concerns such as indentation level and per-language indentation amount.
It only makes sense at the compilation unit level; modules will need to organize their source code in
language-specific structure, such as a Java JAR file.

This class does not support pretty-printing; it will produce code that may exceed the desired line length.

Most methods return the same instance, allowing chaining.

@see Code.Node#write
name: Code.Writer
